summary: item3 (VMProtect-packed LightBurn 1.1.02) license bypass = exactly 5 surgical .text code patches, applied BEFORE VMP packing. No .data or other-section file-level patches (file-initialized .data is byte-identical to genuine 1.1.02). All other section diffs are VMP artifacts (IAT thunk/garbage replacement, exception-dir rewrite, TLS byte, zeroed _RDATA table).
method: Runtime memory dumps via /proc/PID/mem polling (no debugger; avoids VMP anti-debug which triggers on DR registers / 0xCC bytes). Dump A = earliest app-running state (t=2.4478s, first non-zero .data). Diffed each section against version-matched genuine 1.1.02 reference (work/unpacked/prefix1102/drive_c/lb1102/LightBurn.exe).

.text.note: 92,993 import-thunk rewrites (FF15/FF25 IAT -> push/E8E9 to .vmp0/.vmp1) + 5 real patches

.rdata.note: IAT slots replaced with VMP thunk/garbage pointers; no meaningful data patches

.data.note: file-initialized region (first 0x31200 bytes) BYTE-IDENTICAL to genuine; BSS all zeros

text_patches.effect: force conditional je into unconditional jmp to same target 0x3A1960
zero esi (return of call 0x1404C09D0) and force the global@RVA 0x11D08FE load to read 0, so 'test al,al; je 0x3A48F5' is ALWAYS taken
force ebx=0 after call 0x1404C1040, so 'test ebx,ebx; jne 0x3A4930' is NOT taken (falls through)
write 6 instead of 3 to license-state global @ RVA 0x11D08FD (adjacent store writes 4 to RVA 0x122AEC5, unchanged)
force conditional ja into unconditional jmp to same target 0x3B0239

patch_region: RVA 0x3A18B2 .. 0x3B0179 (contiguous ~59KB license-evaluation code; VMP left it native, not virtualized)

globals_touched.note: P2: load replaced with constant 0 (not written)

vmp_antidebug: triggers on DR registers (hw breakpoints) or 0xCC bytes (sw breakpoints), NOT on ptrace stops. Trap site VA 0x14309F67B (.vmp1). Passive tracing / pure /proc/PID/mem polling is safe. Wine does not set PEB.BeingDebugged under ptrace.
